notes: v4: extension list aligned with PlatformDetector.AUTO_TRUSTED_EXTENSIONS (unambiguous formats only). md/sms/gg/sg/gz/cue/chd/hes removed from auto-scan list — they collide with everyday files (Markdown docs, SMS backups, log archives, firmware images). Zip entries are content-probed (arcade signature extensions / driver name / trusted platform extensions) before classification; .apk is explicitly excluded. Unrecognized files are skipped, never guessed.
